trello.name: Finalize Venue Contract
trello.desc: Diego to get the convention center contract through legal review and signed by end of next week. Confirm the AV package includes recording in all three rooms. Steps: 1) Obtain legal review and approval, 2) Ensure all room recordings are included in AV package, 3) Get the contract signed. Acceptance Criteria: Signed contract with recording capabilities confirmed for all rooms.

trello.name: Lock Speaker Lineup
trello.desc: Bo to ensure the speaker lineup is finalized in two weeks. Follow up with the two potential speakers with a decision deadline by Friday. Use backup list if required. Steps: 1) Send follow-up emails to two potential speakers, 2) Use backups if needed, 3) Finalize the list in two weeks for agenda printing. Acceptance Criteria: List of nine confirmed speakers by deadline.

trello.name: Obtain Keynote Abstract
trello.desc: Bo to follow up with Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract needed for the website and printed program. Steps: 1) Contact Dr. Osei and request the abstract, 2) Ensure receipt of abstract by the end of the week. Acceptance Criteria: Keynote abstract received and ready for publication.

trello.name: Execute Marketing Email Campaign
trello.desc: Diego to draft and execute the email campaign in three waves. 1) Agenda announcement upon lineup lock, 2) Early-bird deadline reminder two weeks prior, 3) Final-week registration push. All drafts to be completed this month. Steps: 1) Prepare and schedule agenda announcement email, 2) Draft early-bird reminder email, 3) Draft final-week push email. Acceptance Criteria: Emails drafted, scheduled, and sent as planned.

trello.name: Update Speaker Pages on Website
trello.desc: Bo to provide bios and headshots to Diego for website update once lineup is locked. Steps: 1) Finalize speaker lineup, 2) Collect bios and headshots from all speakers, 3) Deliver assets to Diego on the same day. Acceptance Criteria: Speaker pages updated on the website before the first email wave.

trello.name: Approve and Order Swag
trello.desc: Camille to review and approve the design proofs for the swag, ready for Diego to place the order. Steps: 1) Review design proofs in shared drive, 2) Approve or request changes, 3) Diego to place the order once approved. Acceptance Criteria: Swag order placed with sufficient lead time for delivery.
